page.searchPlaceholder: Search — title, catalog ID, shelf mark, defect
page.unavailable: This item no longer waits here
list.emptyNeeded: Nothing needs review in your custody.
decision.pageError: Enter the pages counted, a whole number
decision.scanConflict: It has been scanned meanwhile; the scan counts the pages.
detail.checksClear: The checks found nothing left to rule on
detail.handedOverSummary: Reclassified into a category outside your custody; whoever holds it reviews it now
detail.cancelledSummary: Held where it was; it stays in Documents, with Resume
detail.sameFindings: The catalog record still gives the same findings. Repair it in the catalog first.
detail.denialLapses: The denial lapses on its own once the defect is gone — repair it in the catalog, then Recheck.
detail.foundAfterScan: Found after the scan exists, so progress does not move back. Accepting records it as tolerable; denying marks it {{progress}} · denied in review.
detail.allDefectsAccepted: Every current defect has been ruled tolerable. Revoking returns it to the queue.
detail.byRule: by a rule, never a person
detail.notAskedAgain_one: Not asked again: the last check found it unchanged. Only what is new is outstanding.
detail.notAskedAgain_other: Not asked again: the last check found them unchanged. Only what is new is outstanding.
action.noVerdict: You may no longer give this verdict.
action.defectsChanged: The defects have changed meanwhile; look again.
action.denyDescription: Rule the defects substantial. It is held until they are repaired in the catalog; the denial lapses once they are gone.
action.aboutRecordPlaceholder: About the record, never a motive
action.cancelConflict: It is already held, or it has been scanned meanwhile.
action.cancelDescription: Hold it at the gate. It stays in Documents, where Resume lets it through again.
action.cancelPlaceholder: e.g. Postponed — will be scheduled next quarter.
action.overruleAdvice: Overrule it from Documents — More → Overrule restriction…; the rule is re-checked on every change to the record, and a re-check that no longer finds it clears it.
action.noOverruleAdvice: Nothing here acts on a restriction. If the rule is wrong for this item, message an administrator: they can overrule it. A re-check that no longer finds it clears it by itself.
action.restrictionRule: A restriction is set by a rule, never by a person.
page.title: Documents
action.denyAfterScanDescription: Rule the defects substantial. It stays {{progress}} and reads denied in review.
detail.validationNote: Repair the record in the catalog, then Recheck: a defect that is gone needs no verdict. Accepting says it is tolerable — a later check finding the same or fewer asks nobody again.
